office_does: A Port of Bellingham commissioner sits on the newly expanded five-member board that sets policy for the county-wide port's shipping terminal, airport, marinas and waterfront property; all Whatcom County voters elect the District 5 (east county) seat in November.
race_blurb: This is one of two new seats created when voters expanded the commission in 2025. Whichever new commissioner draws more votes gets a three-year term and the other a one-year term, though VoteWA lists both as one year. Acme farmer and natural-resource planner Chris Elder, endorsed by Democratic officials and environmental and labor groups, faces Deming refinery foreman and Air Force Reserve veteran Shawn Ensley, whose endorsement page shows Whatcom County Association of Realtors and BUILD PAC logos.

candidates.summary: Acme farmer and natural-resource planner who worked on farmland preservation and watershed planning for Whatcom County and now manages King County's farmland program; first-time candidate.
highlights: Placed first of six in the primary with 41.4% [S8]
Wants port investment in agriculture, forestry, tribal communities and flood-affected east-county towns [S6]
Supports legacy-contamination cleanup and high standards for new development given rising seas [S1]
Endorsed by Sen. Shewmake, Reps. Ramel and Timmons, Whatcom Democrats, Sierra Club, Lummi Nation and Firefighters Local 106 [S4]

candidates.summary: Lifelong Whatcom County resident raised in Acme and Deming, instrumentation and electrical shop foreman at BP Cherry Point and 21-year Air Force Reserve logistics veteran; first-time candidate.
highlights: Placed second of six in the primary with 21.4% [S9]
Wants the port focused on its mission statement and living-wage jobs, including at the shipping terminal [S1][S2]
Says the working waterfront should stay working and backs expanded air service [S5]
Endorsement page shows Realtors and BUILD PAC logos [S7]
